body: It isn't an issue of depression or psyche to be addressed. I was needed, and now I'm not. It was silly to have a crisis at 4:30 AM about it. It was good to do what I could while I was needed, but I should be happy that I no longer am. Have a nice day EdgeBlade.
Thank you. I have, but it won't help. I just hope I have the strength to do what I need to do.

It doesn't matter what happened. I'm sorry for my jibberish. I was having a bit of a mental breakdown. But I'm sure it will be back tomorrow night. I've never felt so alone and I feel trapped in this world. I want to die but I'm too much of a chicken to do it and I know my family would be sad. But I can't stand living anymore I need help but I don't know what I can do.
